day_shape: 48 items dominated by Khamenei's second-day funeral in Tehran with regime channels reporting 7.14 million metro journeys and 900 foreign journalists, Mojtaba Khamenei absent per Jerusalem Post; Trump claims US 'destroyed Iran's navy'; two IDF killings in south Lebanon buffer zone.

threads.label: Khamenei funeral: second day in Tehran
threads.summary: Regime channels ran heavy live coverage of the funeral prayer at Imam Khomeini Prayer Ground, with Defa Press and IRIB posting aerial imagery, elegy readings and logistical notices including pharmacy and bus continuity. Defa Press said 7,141,212 Tehran Metro journeys were recorded overnight and IRIB said around 900 foreign journalists were accredited; Tehran mayor Alireza Zakani and Saeed Jalili were shown attending.

threads.label: External framing of Khamenei funeral
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel covered the second day of the funeral, reporting that Khamenei's son Mojtaba did not attend citing assassination fears and that Khamenei had not been seen publicly since being injured in the 28 February US-Israeli strikes that killed his father, wife and son. Iran International said Quran verses recited for foreign delegations were tailored as political messaging, and framed the ceremony as an attempt to recast a wartime death as martyrdom.

threads.label: Post-war Iran succession and command
threads.summary: Iran International reported Rear Admiral Ali Azmaei has emerged as IRGC Navy commander without a formal decree, replacing Alireza Tangsiri who was killed in the March war. A separate Iran International piece described public rifts inside Tehran over censorship, negotiations and the system's future following the Iran-US truce.

threads.label: US posture on Iran after the war
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Trump told the Salute to America Celebration that the US had 'fully defeated Iran' and destroyed its navy 'in a moment'. Former Israeli deputy foreign minister Danny Ayalon called the current US-Iran deal a 'massive surrender', and Jerusalem Post also disclosed Israel deployed an Iron Dome battery and dozens of IDF troops to the UAE during the recent war.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said reservists of the 551st Brigade shot dead an armed Hezbollah operative in the Majdal Zoun area inside the southern Lebanon buffer zone, calling it a blatant violation of the agreement. The military also announced last week's strikes killed Hamas Nukhba platoon commander Muhammad Najib Ashour and cell commander Tamer Saeed Abu Nakhal in Gaza.

events.source_detail: Times of Israel · military correspondent · X (via rss.app)
events.title: Two Hamas operatives who were advancing attacks on troops in Gaza were killed in strikes last week, the military announces. The strikes killed Muhammad Najib Ashour, a platoon commander in Hamas's Nukhba Force, and Tamer Saeed Abu Nakhal, a commander of a cell in Hamas's military wing, according to the IDF. "The two terrorists, who were involved in advancing attacks against IDF troops, posed a threat to the troops and were subsequently eliminated in precise strikes," the military says.
events.summary:
Two Hamas operatives who were advancing attacks on troops in Gaza were killed in strikes last week, the military announces.  

The strikes killed Muhammad Najib Ashour, a platoon commander in Hamas's Nukhba Force, and Tamer Saeed Abu Nakhal, a commander of a cell in Hamas's military wing, according to the IDF.

"The two terrorists, who were involved in advancing attacks against IDF troops, posed a threat to the troops and were subsequently eliminated in precise strikes," the military says.

events.title_en: All rapid bus transit lines in Tehran are operational — Mehdi Alizada, managing director of Tehran's unified bus company, reported on uninterrupted services by the capital's bus fleet from 7 p.m. on Friday 12 Tir until today. All rapid transit lines have been operational since Friday evening. From Friday, line 109 has been converted into two circular routes from Javanmard Ghassab station to Kerman station and from Laleh terminal to Janbazans Bridge, and this continues until the end of the farewell ceremony. On line 105 as well, in the first loop from Science and Technology station to Seyyed Khandan Bridge and in the second loop from Science and Technology Bridge on Sayyad Shirazi expressway, they are providing services. Apart from rapid transit lines, circular routes are provided at 42 locations

events.title: An armed Hezbollah operative identified near Israeli forces in southern Lebanon earlier today was killed following a manhunt, the military says.
